environment.description: Tomcat 9.0.62 application server deployed on EC2 behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode on port 443). No origin checking middleware. WebSocket upgrade requests pass through without inspection. The frontend is served from the same origin with standard CSP: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com. No SRI enforcement on dynamically loaded scripts. IAM role attached to EC2 has sqs:ReceiveMessage and sqs:DeleteMessage on arn:aws:sqs:*:*:* (wildcard). No VPC endpoint policy restrictions on SQS.
